title: Tafiya da hutu
description: Ten short, simple stories about travel and holidays in Hausaland and beyond: a climb up the Shere hills, a fishing trip to an island in the River Niger, the Sallah durbar in Kano, a visa for London, a class trip to the old city walls, a trader cheated in Maradi, a hot-season visit to a village, a football team at the national games, a car journey held up by an accident and a boy from London who visits his grandmother.

lessons.title: Tsaunin Shere
lessons.summary: Saminu, a teacher in Jos, spends his holiday climbing the Shere hills with his wife Ladidi; she gets tired halfway, but they reach the top and see their town below.
lessons.text:
Saminu malami ne a Jos. A ƙarshen shekara, makarantarsa ta ba shi hutu na mako uku.

"Me za mu yi a lokacin hutun nan?" matarsa Ladidi ta ce.

"Ina so mu hau tsaunin Shere," Saminu ya ce. "Tun ina yaro ina ganin tsaunin daga gida, amma ban taɓa hawa ba."

"Tsaunin yana da tsawo sosai," Ladidi ta ce. "Zan gaji."

"Ba za ki gaji ba," Saminu ya ce. "Za mu tafi a hankali."

Washegari da safe suka ɗauki ruwa da abinci, suka tafi ƙasan tsaunin. Wani mutum a wurin ya ce musu, "Tsaunin nan yana da tsawon mita ɗari shida. Akwai matakan dutse har zuwa rabin tsaunin. Bayan rabin, babu matakan, sai ƙaramar hanya."

Suka fara hawa. Matakan suna da yawa ƙwarai. Bayan awa ɗaya, Ladidi ta tsaya. "Na gaji," ta ce. "Ka ba ni ruwa."

Saminu ya ba ta ruwa. "Mun kai rabin tsaunin," ya ce. "Saura rabi kawai."

Suka zauna a kan wani dutse. Saminu ya nuna wani wuri a ƙasa. "Kin gan shi? Gidanmu ke nan."

"Ban gan shi ba," Ladidi ta ce. Sai ta sake duba. "Yanzu na gan shi! Gidanmu ƙarami ne daga nan."

Bayan sun huta, suka ci gaba da hawa. Babu matakan yanzu, kuma hanyar tana da wuya. Saminu ma ya gaji, amma bai faɗa ba.

Da suka kai saman tsaunin, Ladidi ta yi dariya. "Mun hau mita ɗari shida!" ta ce. "Ka faɗa mini gaskiya: kai ma ka gaji, ko?"

"Na gaji," Saminu ya ce. "Amma wannan ne hutu mafi kyau a rayuwata."

Da suka koma gida da yamma, Ladidi ta ce, "Ka kawo mini ruwan zafi, sannan in tafi gado."

Saminu ya kawo mata ruwa, sannan su biyu suka tafi gado da wuri. A cikin gado, Ladidi ta ce, "Gobe ba zan hau ko matakan gidanmu ba."

Tambayoyi:
Hutu na mako nawa makarantar Saminu ta ba shi?
Ta ba shi hutu na mako uku.
Tsaunin Shere yana da tsawon mita nawa?
Yana da tsawon mita ɗari shida.
Ina matakan dutse suke?
Matakan suna nan har zuwa rabin tsaunin.
Me Ladidi ta ce a rabin tsaunin?
Ta ce, "Na gaji. Ka ba ni ruwa."
Me suka gani daga kan dutse?
Sun ga gidansu a ƙasa.

lessons.title: Tsibiri a kogin Nijar
lessons.summary: Ilyasu, a fisherman near Niamey, takes his son Bilal to an island in the River Niger; on the way home the boat gets a hole, and they bail out the water until they reach the bank safely.
lessons.text:
Ilyasu yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Niamey, a bakin kogin Nijar. Aikinsa kama kifi ne. Yana da ƙaramin jirgin ruwa mai inji.

Ɗansa Bilal yana hutun makaranta. Wata rana Ilyasu ya ce masa, "Gobe za mu je wani tsibiri a tsakiyar kogi. A can akwai kifi da yawa."

Washegari suka hau jirgin. Ilyasu ya nuna wa Bilal yadda ake sarrafa injin. "Ka riƙe nan," ya ce. "Ka sarrafa injin a hankali." Bilal ya sarrafa shi da kyau, kuma jirgin ya tafi har tsibirin.

A tsibirin suka kama kifi da yawa, manya da ƙanana. Da dare ya yi, suka zauna a bakin ruwa suna kallon taurari. Ilyasu ya nuna wa ɗansa wani babban tauraro. "Wannan tauraro yana nuna mini hanyar gida idan dare ya yi," ya ce.

Da safe suka sa kifin a cikin jirgin, suka kama hanyar gida. A tsakiyar kogi, jirgin ya bugi wani dutse a cikin ruwa. Sai wani rami ya buɗe a ƙasan jirgin. Ruwa ya fara shiga ta ramin.

"Da gaggawa!" Ilyasu ya ce. "Ɗauki wannan kwano, ka kwashe ruwan, ka zuba shi a cikin kogi!"

Bilal ya ɗauki kwano. Yana kwashe ruwa yana zuba shi a waje. Ilyasu kuma ya sa riga a cikin ramin, don kada ruwa ya ƙara shiga.

Bilal yana jin tsoron faɗawa cikin ruwa, saboda bai iya iyo ba. "Ka zauna a tsakiyar jirgin," babansa ya ce. "Ka yi hankali da faɗawa cikin ruwa."

Ilyasu ya sarrafa injin, ya kai jirgin bakin kogi da gaggawa. Bilal bai daina ba: yana kwashe ruwa, yana zuba shi a waje.

Da suka isa bakin kogi, Ilyasu ya rungumi ɗansa. "Mun tsira," ya ce. "Kuma mun tsira da kifinmu duka."

Da yamma suka sayar da kifin a kasuwa. Ilyasu ya ba Bilal kuɗi. "Wannan naka ne," ya ce. "Kai ne ka kwashe ruwan."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Ilyasu yake zaune?
Yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Niamey, a bakin kogin Nijar.
Me ya sa suka je tsibirin?
Saboda a can akwai kifi da yawa.
Me Ilyasu ya nuna wa ɗansa da dare?
Ya nuna masa wani babban tauraro.
Me ya faru da jirgin a tsakiyar kogi?
Jirgin ya bugi dutse, sai rami ya buɗe a ƙasansa.
Me Bilal ya yi da kwano?
Ya kwashe ruwa, ya zuba shi a cikin kogi.

lessons.title: Ranar Sallah a Kano
lessons.summary: Yasir comes from Abuja on a Sallah visit to his cousin Mariya in Kano; they attend the durbar, admire the caps and the riders' style, and in the afternoon Yasir wins the children's race.
lessons.text:
Yasir yana zaune a Abuja. A lokacin Sallah, shi da mahaifiyarsa suka zo ziyara a gidan 'yar uwar mahaifiyarsa a Kano. 'Yarta Mariya tana da shekara goma, kamar Yasir.

"Wannan ce ziyararka ta farko a Kano?" Mariya ta ce.

"Haka ne," Yasir ya ce. "Kuma ina so in halarci babban bikin Sallah na sarki."

"Za mu halarci bikin tare," Mariya ta ce. "Kowace shekara ina zuwa tare da babana."

Da safe babanta ya ba Yasir wata sabuwar hula. Hular tana da kyawu ƙwarai, kuma tana da zane ja da fari. "Saka ta," ya ce. "A Kano, a ranar Sallah, kowane namiji yana saka hula."

Suka tafi ƙofar gidan sarki. Jama'a suna da yawa. Kowa ya saka kaya masu kyawu. Yasir ya ga maza da yawa a kan doki, kuma kowane mutum yana da nasa salo. Wani yana saka babbar riga fara, wani kuma ja.

"Ka ga salon waɗannan mutane?" Mariya ta ce. "Wannan tsohon salo ne na Kano."

Sai bugawar ganga ta fara. Bugawar tana da ƙarfi sosai, kuma mutane suna rawa. Bayan haka sarki ya fito tare da tawagarsa. Tawagar tana da mutane da yawa, kuma duk suna kan doki. Mutane suka yi murna, suna cewa, "Allah ya ja zamanin sarki!"

Da rana, yara suka yi wasanni a filin da ke kusa da gidan Mariya. Akwai wasanni da yawa, kuma na ƙarshe tsere ne. "Ka shiga tseren," Mariya ta ce wa Yasir.

Yara goma suka shiga tseren. Yasir ya yi gudu da ƙarfi, kuma shi ne ya zo na farko. Wani tsoho ya ba shi kyauta.

Da dare Yasir ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa, "Wannan ce ziyara mafi kyau a rayuwata. Ina so in halarci bikin Sallah a Kano kowace shekara."

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina Yasir ya zo ziyara?
Ya zo daga Abuja.
Me baban Mariya ya ba Yasir?
Ya ba shi wata sabuwar hula mai kyawu.
Wa ya fito tare da tawagarsa?
Sarki ne ya fito tare da tawagarsa.
Wane wasa ne na ƙarshe?
Tsere ne na ƙarshe.
Wa ya zo na farko a tseren?
Yasir ne ya zo na farko.

lessons.title: Izinin zuwa Landan
lessons.summary: Hamsatu in Kaduna wants to visit her daughter Samira in London for the holidays; her son Najib helps her work out the costs, fill in her details online and wait for permission, which comes after three weeks.
lessons.text:
Hamsatu tana zaune a Kaduna. 'Yarta Samira tana aiki a Landan. Wata rana Samira ta kira ta a waya. "Mama, ki zo Landan lokacin hutu," ta ce. "Ki zauna tare da mu sati huɗu."

Hamsatu ta yi farin ciki, amma ba ta san yadda ake shirya irin wannan tafiya ba. Sai ta kira ɗanta Najib.

Najib ya zo da kwamfutarsa. "Mama, za mu yi komai a yanar gizo," ya ce. Ya duba farashin jirgin sama a yanar gizo. "Farashin yana da yawa a lokacin hutu," ya ce. "Bari mu yi lissafi."

Suka yi lissafin kuɗin jirgi, kuɗin izini da kuɗin mota zuwa Abuja. Bayan lissafin, Hamsatu ta ce, "Ina da kuɗin."

Najib ya ce, "Kafin ki tafi, dole ki samu izinin shiga ƙasar." Ya buɗe shafin ofishin izini a yanar gizo. "Sun buƙaci bayananki," ya ce. "Sunanki, ranar haihuwarki, aikinki da adireshinki."

Ya cika bayananta duka. "Har ila yau sun buƙaci takardar tabbaci daga Samira," ya ce. "Tabbaci ne cewa za ki zauna a gidanta, kuma za ki dawo gida."

Samira ta aiko da takardar tabbaci. Najib ya kai Hamsatu Abuja, sai ta ba ofishin takardunta.

"Yaushe za su ba ni izini?" Hamsatu ta ce.

"Wataƙila bayan sati biyu," Najib ya ce. "Wataƙila bayan sati uku."

Sati biyu suka wuce. Hamsatu ta ce, "Har ila yau ba su ba ni amsa ba. Ko ba za su ba ni izini ba?"

"A'a, Mama," Najib ya ce. "Ki jira kawai."

A sati na uku, wani saƙo ya zo. An ba Hamsatu izini! Ta kira Samira. "Kin ji labari?" ta ce. "Zan zo Landan!"

"Kin sayi tikitin jirgi?" Samira ta ce.

"A'a, tukuna," Hamsatu ta ce. "Gobe Najib zai saya mini a yanar gizo."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Samira take aiki?
Tana aiki a Landan.
Me Najib da mahaifiyarsa suka yi kafin su sayi tikiti?
Sun yi lissafin kuɗin jirgi, kuɗin izini da kuɗin mota.
Me ofishin ya buƙaci?
Ya buƙaci bayanan Hamsatu da takardar tabbaci daga Samira.
Bayan sati nawa aka ba Hamsatu izini?
An ba ta izini a sati na uku.
Wa zai saya mata tikiti?
Najib ne zai saya mata a yanar gizo.

lessons.title: Ziyarar aji a ganuwar Zaria
lessons.summary: Malama Wasila takes her class in Zaria to see the old city walls; a history expert teaches them in groups, and shy Atika finally asks a question and learns the most.
lessons.text:
Malama Wasila tana koyar da tarihi a wata makarantar 'yan mata a Zaria. Ajinta yana da ɗalibai talatin. A ranar ƙarshe kafin hutu, ta kai ajinta ziyara a tsohuwar ganuwar birnin Zaria.

Kafin su tafi, ta ba su umarni. "Kowace ɗaliba ta zauna tare da rukuninta," ta ce. "Kada wata ta tafi ita kaɗai. Kuma ku yi kulawa sosai: ganuwar tana da tsawo, kuma wasu wurare ba su da kyau."

"Za mu yi kulawa, malama," ɗalibai suka ce.

Ta raba ajin rukuni uku. Kowane rukuni yana da ɗalibai goma.

A wurin, wani masani ya zo ya koyar da su. Masanin tarihi ne daga jami'a. "Wannan ganuwa tana da shekara ɗari da yawa," ya ce. "Kakannin mutanen Zaria ne suka gina ta don su kare birninsu."

Rukunin farko ya yi sauraro da kyau. Rukuni na biyu ma ya yi sauraro. Amma a rukuni na uku, wasu 'yan mata suna magana, ba sa sauraro.

A cikin wannan rukuni akwai wata ɗaliba, Atika. Atika tana jin kunya ƙwarai. Tana sauraron masanin sosai, amma ba ta taɓa yin tambaya a aji ba saboda kunya.

Malama Wasila ta zo kusa da ita. "Atika, kina da tambaya?" ta ce.

Atika ta dubi ƙasa saboda kunya. Sai ta ce a hankali, "Ta yaya kakanninmu suka gina ganuwar nan ba tare da mota ba?"

Masanin ya yi murmushi. "Tambaya mai kyau ce," ya ce. Ya bayyana yadda mutane da yawa suka yi aiki tare da ƙasa da ruwa har shekaru masu yawa.

Bayan sun koma makaranta, Malama Wasila ta ba ajin aikin rubutu. Atika ce ta rubuta mafi kyau. "Kin koyi abubuwa da yawa," malamar ta ce.

"Na koyi abubuwa da yawa saboda na yi tambaya," Atika ta ce. "Daga yau ba zan ji kunya a aji ba."

Tambayoyi:
Wane darasi Malama Wasila take koyarwa?
Tana koyar da tarihi.
Wane umarni ta ba ɗalibanta?
Ta ce kowace ɗaliba ta zauna tare da rukuninta.
Wa ya koyar da su a ganuwar?
Wani masanin tarihi daga jami'a ne ya koyar da su.
Me ya sa Atika ba ta yin tambaya a aji?
Saboda tana jin kunya ƙwarai.
Me Atika ta koya daga wannan ziyara?
Ta koyi abubuwa da yawa saboda ta yi tambaya.

lessons.title: Cinikin Sanusi a Maradi
lessons.summary: Sanusi, a cloth trader from Kano, takes his goods to Maradi before the holiday; a buyer lies to him and does not pay, so a lawyer takes the matter to court, and the judge orders the man to pay.
lessons.text:
Sanusi ɗan kasuwa ne a Kano. Yana cinikin zane. Kafin hutun Sallah, galibi yana kai kayansa Maradi, a ƙasar Nijar, saboda mutane suna saya da yawa a lokacin.

A wannan shekara Sanusi ya sa duk jarinsa a cikin kaya. "Idan ciniki ya yi kyau, jarina zai yi girma," ya ce wa kansa.

A Maradi, wani mutum mai suna Sadau ya zo wurinsa. "Galibi ina saya daga 'yan kasuwar Kano," Sadau ya ce. "Zan ba ka rabin kuɗin yau, sauran gobe."

Sanusi ya yi zaton Sadau mutumin kirki ne. A zatonsa, ciniki ne mai kyau. Sai ya ba shi kayan.

Kwana ɗaya ya wuce, amma Sadau bai zo ba. Sanusi ya je gidansa. "Ina sauran kuɗina?" ya ce.

"Ban san ka ba," Sadau ya ce. "Waɗannan kaya nawa ne, ba naka ba."

Sanusi ya ji fushi ƙwarai. "Wannan ƙarya ce!" ya ce. "Kana faɗin ƙarya a gaban jama'a!"

Wasu 'yan kasuwa biyu suka zo. "Mun gan ka lokacin da ka karɓi kayan," suka ce wa Sadau. "Kayan nan ba naka ba ne. Na Sanusi ne."

Sanusi ya bar fushinsa, ya je wurin wani lauya, Lawan. Lauyan ya ji labarinsa, sannan ya ce, "Kada ka damu. Za mu kai maganar kotu. Kotu tana yin adalci."

A kotu, alƙali ya ce wa 'yan kasuwan nan biyu, "Zanen nan naku ne?"

"A'a, ba namu ba ne," suka ce. "Mun ga Sadau yana karɓar zanen daga hannun Sanusi."

"Zanen ba nasu ba ne, kuma ba na Sadau ba ne," alƙali ya ce. "Na Sanusi ne. Sadau ya faɗi ƙarya. Adalci shi ne ya biya Sanusi sauran kuɗinsa a cikin kwana uku."

Sadau ya biya. Sanusi bai yi hasara ba, amma ya ce, "Da ban samu lauya na kirki ba, da na yi babbar hasara."

Wani tsoho a kasuwa ya ce masa, "Saboda haka ne ake cewa, ciniki sai da gaskiya. Mutum ɗaya mai ƙarya yana iya sa kowa ya yi hasara."

Tambayoyi:
Me Sanusi yake ciniki?
Yana cinikin zane.
Me Sadau ya faɗa a gidansa?
Ya ce kayan nasa ne, ba na Sanusi ba.
Me alƙali ya ce game da zanen?
Ya ce zanen ba nasu ba ne, na Sanusi ne.
Me alƙali ya ce Sadau ya yi?
Ya ce Sadau ya biya Sanusi sauran kuɗinsa a cikin kwana uku.

lessons.title: Bazara a ƙauye
lessons.summary: Basiru visits his wife Umaima's village near Sokoto in the hot season; there is no electricity, he sleeps without a net, catches malaria and loses his appetite, and pills and rest make him well.
lessons.text:
Basiru yana aiki a Abuja. A lokacin hutu, shi da matarsa Umaima suka je ƙauyensu kusa da Sokoto. Lokacin bazara ne, kuma rana tana da zafi ƙwarai.

A ƙauyen babu wutar lantarki. "Ba mu da lantarki a nan," mahaifin Umaima ya ce. "Amma muna da bishiya."

A gaban gidan akwai wata babbar bishiya. Da rana, kowa yana zama a ƙarƙashin bishiyar. Akwai iska, kuma akwai sanyi kaɗan. "Wannan ne wurin shakatawarmu," Umaima ta ce.

Basiru ya ji daɗin shakatawa a ƙarƙashin bishiyar. Amma bai daɗe a can ba, domin ba ya son daɗewa a wuri ɗaya. Yana so ya ga ƙauyen. Da rana ya yi yawo a cikin zafin rana ba tare da hula ba. "Ka yi hankali," Umaima ta ce. "Zafin bazara yana da illa ga jiki."

Da dare, Umaima ta ba shi gidan sauro. "Wannan kariya ce daga sauro," ta ce. "Kada ka kwanta ba tare da kariya ba."

Amma Basiru ya ce, "Zafi ya yi yawa. Ba na so in kwanta a ciki." Sai ya kwanta a waje ba tare da kariya ba.

Bayan kwana uku, sai ya ji ciwon kai da sanyi a jikinsa. Ba ya jin yunwa ko kaɗan. "Ba na jin yunwa," ya ce. "Ba zan ci abinci ba."

Umaima ta kai shi wani ƙaramin asibiti. Likitan ya duba shi, sannan ya ce, "Ka kamu da zazzaɓin cizon sauro. Mutane da yawa sun kamu da shi a wannan lokaci."

Likitan ya ba shi ƙwayoyi. "Ka sha waɗannan ƙwayoyi sau biyu a rana har kwana uku," ya ce. "Ka kwanta a gado, kuma ka sha ruwa da yawa."

Basiru ya sha ƙwayoyin, ya kwanta a gado har kwana biyu. A rana ta uku, ya ji yunwa. "Ina jin yunwa yanzu!" ya ce. Zazzaɓin bai daɗe ba. Umaima ta yi dariya, ta kawo masa abinci.

Bayan haka, kowane dare Basiru yakan kwanta a cikin gidan sauro. "Na koyi illar rashin kariya," ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Yaya ƙauyen yake a lokacin bazara?
Rana tana da zafi ƙwarai, kuma babu wutar lantarki.
Ina kowa yake zama da rana?
Kowa yana zama a ƙarƙashin babbar bishiya.
Me Umaima ta ba Basiru da dare?
Ta ba shi gidan sauro don kariya.
Da me Basiru ya kamu?
Ya kamu da zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Me likitan ya ba shi?
Ya ba shi ƙwayoyi.

lessons.title: 'Yan wasan Gombe
lessons.summary: A young football team from Gombe represents its state at the national games in Abuja; the government's support pays for the journey, the coach trusts his young captain Yahuza, and the team reaches the final.
lessons.text:
Yahuza yana da shekara goma sha bakwai. Yana buga ƙwallo a wata ƙungiyar matasa a Gombe. A wannan shekara, ƙungiyarsu ce take wakiltar jihar Gombe a gasar wasanni ta ƙasa a Abuja.

Amma tafiya zuwa Abuja tana buƙatar kuɗi, kuma ƙungiyar ba ta da kuɗi. Shugaban ƙungiyar, Malam Zakariya, ya yi gwagwarmaya har mako biyu. Ya je wurare da yawa yana neman tallafi.

Kafin a ba su tallafi, dole gwamnan jiha ya ba da amincewarsa. Daga baya, amincewar gwamna ta zo.

A ƙarshe gwamnatin jiha ta ba su tallafi. "Kuna wakiltar jihar Gombe," wani jami'i ya ce. "Wannan tallafi zai biya motarku da abincinku."

Malam Zakariya mutum ne mai ƙwarewa. Ya yi shekaru da yawa yana koyar da matasa wasan ƙwallo. Ya kuma nemi amincewar iyayen 'yan wasan, kuma duk suka ba da amincewarsu. Kafin su tafi, ya kira haɗuwar 'yan wasa. "Ina so in zaɓi shugaban 'yan wasa," ya ce. "Yahuza, shugabanci zai zama naka."

Yahuza ya yi mamaki. "Ban taɓa yin shugabanci ba," ya ce.

"Shugabanci yana buƙatar fiye da ƙwarewa," Malam Zakariya ya ce. "Dole ka dogara ga abokanka, su ma su dogara gare ka."

A Abuja, adadin ƙungiyoyin da suka zo yana da yawa: ƙungiyoyi ashirin da huɗu. Gombe ta ci wasan farko da ci biyu da ɗaya. Ta kuma ci wasa na biyu.

Kafin wasan ƙarshe, Yahuza ya yi haɗuwa da 'yan wasan. "Mun zo nan don wakiltar jiharmu," ya ce. "Mu dogara ga juna."

A wasan ƙarshe, Gombe ba ta ci ba. Sun yi rashin nasara da ci ɗaya. Amma Malam Zakariya bai yi fushi ba. "Kun yi gwagwarmaya sosai," ya ce. "Daga cikin adadin ƙungiyoyi ashirin da huɗu, ku ne na biyu."

Da suka koma Gombe, mutane da yawa suka zo tasha suna murna.

Tambayoyi:
Wace jiha ƙungiyar Yahuza take wakilta?
Tana wakiltar jihar Gombe.
Wa ya ba ƙungiyar tallafi?
Gwamnatin jiha ce ta ba su tallafi.
Wa Malam Zakariya ya ba shugabanci?
Ya ba Yahuza shugabanci.
Mene ne adadin ƙungiyoyin da suka zo Abuja?
Ƙungiyoyi ashirin da huɗu ne suka zo.
Gombe ta zo na nawa?
Gombe ta zo na biyu.

lessons.title: Labari a rediyo
lessons.summary: Dije is travelling by car from Kaduna to a wedding in Zaria when the radio reports an accident on the road and a threat of heavy rain; the travellers discuss what to do, wait in a village and arrive safely.
lessons.text:
Dije tana zaune a Kaduna. A lokacin hutu, tana da niyyar zuwa bikin auren 'yar uwarta a Zaria. "Niyyata ita ce in isa Zaria kafin dare," ta ce wa kanta.

Ta shiga motar Hafiz a tasha. A cikin motar akwai mutane huɗu. Hafiz yana son sauraron rediyo, kuma rediyonsa yana kunne koyaushe.

Bayan awa ɗaya a hanya, sai rediyo ya watsa wani labari. "An yi hatsari a babbar hanyar Kaduna zuwa Zaria," mai labarin ya ce. "Wata babbar mota ta bugi motoci biyu. Babu wanda ya rasa ransa a hatsarin."

Sannan rediyon ya watsa maganar rundunar 'yan sanda ta jihar. Rundunar ta ce direban babbar motar ya karya doka: yana gudu da sauri sosai. "Duk wanda ya karya doka a kan hanya, za mu kama shi," rundunar ta ce. "Kowa ya tsaya har sai mun kwashe motocin daga hanya."

Rediyon ya ƙara watsa wani labari: "Akwai barazanar ruwan sama mai ƙarfi a yammacin yau."

Dije ta so ta kira 'yar uwarta, amma waya ba ta aiki. "Babu sadarwa a wannan wuri," Hafiz ya ce. "Layin sadarwa ba ya kai nan."

Mutanen motar suka tattauna abin da za su yi. Wani ya ce, "Mu koma Kaduna." Wata ta ce, "Mu bi wata hanya." Suka tattauna har minti goma.

"Babu yiwuwar mu bi wata hanya," Hafiz ya ce. "Hanyar tana da nisa, kuma ga barazanar ruwan sama. Akwai yiwuwar 'yan sanda za su buɗe hanyar bayan awa biyu. Mu jira a ƙauyen nan."

Suka jira a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya a ƙauyen. Bayan awa biyu, rediyo ya watsa sabon labari: an buɗe hanyar.

Suka ci gaba da tafiya, kuma suka isa Zaria kafin ruwan sama ya fara. Da sadarwa ta dawo, Dije ta kira 'yar uwarta. "Na iso lafiya," ta ce.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Dije take da niyyar zuwa?
Tana da niyyar zuwa bikin auren 'yar uwarta a Zaria.
Me rediyo ya watsa a hanya?
Ya watsa labarin hatsari a babbar hanyar Kaduna zuwa Zaria.
Me rundunar 'yan sanda ta ce game da direban babbar motar?
Ta ce ya karya doka: yana gudu da sauri sosai.
Me ya sa Dije ba ta iya kiran 'yar uwarta ba?
Saboda babu sadarwa a wurin.
Ina suka jira?
Sun jira a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya a ƙauyen.

lessons.title: Kakar Anas
lessons.summary: Anas, a boy born in London, spends his holiday with his grandmother Uwani in Katsina; his cousin Munira translates for him and is jealous at first, but the three grow close, and grandmother shows him his late grandfather's real home.
lessons.text:
Anas yana da shekara goma sha biyu. An haife shi a Landan, kuma bai taɓa zuwa Najeriya ba. A wannan hutu, iyayensa sun kawo shi Katsina wurin kakarsa Uwani.

Kakansa ya rasu shekara biyu da suka wuce. Anas bai taɓa ganinsa ba. Tun da kakansa ya rasu, kakarsa tana zaune ita kaɗai tare da jikarta Munira.

Anas bai iya yaren kakarsa sosai ba. Kakarsa kuma ba ta iya yaren Ingila ba. Sai Munira ta riƙa fassara musu. Kakar tana magana, Munira tana fassara wa Anas. Anas yana magana, Munira tana fassara wa kakar.

Amma Munira ta fara jin kishi. Kakarsu tana ba Anas abinci mai daɗi, tana yi masa magana da murmushi. "Kakarmu tana son Anas fiye da ni," Munira ta ce a ranta. Kishinta ya sa ba ta so ta ƙara fassara.

Kakar ta gane kishin Munira. Ta kira Munira, ta ce, "Munira, ke jikata ce, shi ma jikana ne. Ina son ku duka. Sabida haka, kada ki ji kishi. Ɗabi'arki tana da kyau. Kina taimaka mini kowace rana."

Munira ta yi murmushi, kuma kishinta ya tafi. Daga ranar, ta fara koya wa Anas yaren kakarsu. Anas ma ya nuna mata wasanni na Landan.

Dangantakar yaran biyu ta haɓaka. Dangantakarsu da kakarsu ma ta haɓaka. Bayan sati uku, Anas yana iya magana da kakarsa ba tare da fassara ba.

Wata rana kakar ta kai su wani tsohon gida a cikin gari. "Wannan ne ainihin gidan kakanku," ta ce. "A nan aka haife shi, kuma a nan ya rayu kafin ya rasu. Ainihin asalinku yana nan."

Anas ya yi shiru. "Ina son ɗabi'ar mutanen nan," ya ce wa kakarsa. "Ina so in dawo kowane hutu."

"Ka dawo, jikana," kakar ta ce. "Sabida dangantaka ba ta mutuwa."

Tambayoyi:
Ina aka haifi Anas?
An haife shi a Landan.
Wa ya rasu shekara biyu da suka wuce?
Kakan Anas ne ya rasu.
Me Munira take yi wa Anas da kakarsa?
Tana fassara musu.
Me ya sa Munira ta ji kishi?
Saboda kakarsu tana ba Anas abinci mai daɗi, tana yi masa magana da murmushi.
Me kakar ta nuna musu a cikin gari?
Ta nuna musu ainihin gidan kakansu.
